gloss: Remember the source of the water you drink.
teaser: Today, we explore a phrase that reminds us to appreciate our roots.
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Today, we explore a phrase that reminds us to appreciate our roots. [break 1s] The phrase is: 饮水思源, yǐn shuǐ sī yuán. [break 1s] 饮 (yǐn) - to drink [break 0.5s] 水 (shuǐ) - water [break 0.5s] 思 (sī) - to think [break 0.5s] 源 (yuán) - source [break 1s] 饮水思源 means 'to drink water and think of its source' literally, and figuratively it suggests remembering your roots and those who helped you. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] This idiom originates from a poem by the ancient philosopher Confucius. He emphasized gratitude and the importance of acknowledging those who have contributed to our lives. Over time, it became a common saying to remind people to be thankful for their origins and support. [break 1.5s] Example 1: 我们在成功时，不要忘记饮水思源。 [break 1s] We should not forget to remember our roots when we achieve success. [break 1s] Example 2: 这个节日是为了饮水思源，感谢我们的祖先。 [break 1s] This festival is to remember the source and thank our ancestors. [break 1s] Example 3: 她总是饮水思源，感恩父母的养育。 [break 1s] She always remembers her roots and is grateful for her parents' upbringing. [break 1s] 饮水思源 means to remember the source of the water you drink. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
